menu_options.add_from_source: Add entity from a source (suggests settings)

add_entity.title: Type and name
add_entity.description: Any number of virtual entities can be built from the same source, for example a text and a number.

data_description.icon: Optional. Without it the entity uses the icon of its source, if the source has one.

entity_source.title: Source and transformation
entity_source.description:
The source entity is never modified. The template can use `value` (state or attribute), `state` and `attributes`.

Examples:
- `'{{' value.split(' - ', 1)[-1] '}}'` turns "18 - Running" into "Running"
- `'{{' value.split(' - ')[0] '}}'` returns just "18"
- `'{{' value.startswith('18') '}}'` for a binary sensor

{preview}

data_description.source_attribute: Optional. Use this attribute instead of the state.
data_description.value_template: Optional. Transforms the value. Without it the value is used unchanged.
data_description.copy_attributes: Optional. Default: none. "Selected attributes" lets you pick them in the next step. Attributes that Home Assistant sets itself (name, icon, unit, classes) are never copied.
data_description.attribute_templates: Optional, YAML: attribute name and template per line, for example `fehlercode: "'{{' attributes.error_code | int '}}'"`. Templates see `value`, `state` and `attributes`. A template overrides a copied attribute of the same name.
data_description.test_template: Shows a preview of what you entered, using the current state of the source, and keeps this form open. Submit again without it to continue.

entity_details.title: Details
entity_details.description:
Actions forward commands to the source integration (prefilled if the source can be controlled directly). They can use `'{{' value '}}'` (number), `'{{' option '}}'` (select) and `'{{' source_entity '}}'`.

Example for a select: `'{{' 18 if option == 'Running' else 19 '}}'`

data_description.options: The value (after the template) must match one option exactly.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Optional. If a unit or class is set, the value must be numeric.
data_description.device_class: Optional. Sensors: only for numeric values. Binary sensors: sets the icon and wording of the states, for example door (open/closed).
data_description.state_class: Optional. Use measurement for values that go up and down.

remove_entity.title: Remove entities
remove_entity.description: Only the virtual entities are deleted. The source entities stay untouched.

add_from_source.title: Choose the source
add_from_source.description:
Pick the entity to build on. Type, name, unit, range and options are suggested from it afterwards, you can change them. The source entity is never modified.

Examples:
- `'{{' value.split(' - ', 1)[-1] '}}'` turns "18 - Running" into "Running"
- `'{{' value.split(' - ')[0] '}}'` returns just "18"
- `'{{' value.startswith('18') '}}'` for a binary sensor

{preview}
